description: This is a header file (.h) for utility functions related to security tokens, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin management within the WPEFramework-based project. It defines structures, utility functions, and classes aimed at facilitating security token retrieval, plugin activation, and service state management.
external_files: json parser library (implied by usage of JsonObject and JsonArray)

classes.name: Utils::SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static method to retrieve a security token, ensuring thread safety and handling security configuration checks.

classes.name: Utils::Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job that executes a given function, used for asynchronous plugin operations.

methods.name: Utils::SecurityToken::getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, checking if security is configured and caching the token.

methods.name: Utils::SecurityToken::writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Static callback for handling curl responses, appending received data to a string stream.

methods.name: Utils::SecurityToken::isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks via an HTTP call if Thunder security subsystem is configured.

methods.name: Utils::getThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a WPEFramework Thunder RPC client link, authenticated with a security token.

methods.name: Utils::getServiceState
methods.description: Queries the state of a service identified by callsign through the plugin shell.

methods.name: Utils::activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates the plugin identified by callsign using the plugin shell.
